Project Code Management

Commiting

Husky is used to integrate Commitizen with git to ensure consitent commit messages are used. This in turn allows us to use Commitizen to produce accurate release notices as part of the Workflows.

Husky

Husky manages git hook scripts. These are put into place when npm run prepare is executed (see Setup Prerequisites).

Commitizen

As part of the Build Process the ([commitizen-tools/commitizen-action](https://github.com/commitizen-tools/commitizen-action)) is run. This will ‘bump’ the version of the project (acccording to rules prescribed in ), updating entries in files identiried in .czrc under version_files.
